title: Blood Donation Milestone Burn-Up
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:donation milestone_name=* milestone_points=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(milestone_points) as metric by _time milestone_name
| sort 0 _time milestone_name
description: Trends monthly milestone points by milestone for blood-donation goals.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether blood-donation goals are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `milestone_name` on `community:donation` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly milestone points.
visualization: Line chart of monthly milestone points by milestone.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how milestone points changes month by month for each milestone so you can see whether blood-donation goals are heading the right way.
